verdict.rationale: Tax calculation is a fair axis for a billing and invoicing platform like Orb. However, the evidence pack contains nothing about sales tax, VAT, GST, tax registrations, or a tax-provider integration. The invoice-calculation material covers only minimums and maximums, so with no evidence for an applicable capability the verdict is none.

support.subject: As a finance lead, sales tax, VAT, and GST are calculated on every invoice — natively or through a first-class tax integration — with the right registrations and rates
